audit_comment: APPENDIX 4 AND THE INDEX - the D&DG walk round twenty-nine, print pp. 143-144 (pdf 144-145): the whole D&DG tail save the pixel work - the seventeen-entry FURTHER REFERENCE bibliography with its intro and the Chaosium credit line, and the 433-term INDEX OF PROPER NAMES across the six column runs. THE TRIPLE GAP FLIP per Curtiss: the App 3, App 4 and index boxes close this round (the R485 doctrine), the census reads 23/1, the alignment figures the lone open box. The print voice: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (the index parsed from the pdf 144/145 column runs against the geometry, the App 4 from the pdf 144 top columns); the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print djvu text (the IA 1eonline chart voice has no index page). THE HEADLINE ADJUDICATIONS: the leading-1 drop class (eight members, Blodug-Hofi found at the final parse review); the fused-glyph pages (Eadro, Vaprak, Jason, Harp of Calm); the name-garble class restored per the walk pins (R’lyeh through Ningauble of the 7 Eyes; the numeral 7 rides the print in both voices); the Caduceus 71 and Nemean lion skin 71 pages (the IA voice drops the leading 7, the geometry reads the two-digit token); the Thrym 113 wrap; the print order quirks (seven, both voices agreeing); the word-convention sorts read as convention; the non-ascending citation lists pinned; the double listings pinned; Rake of Iron the eyeball flag; the Horus stray dash; the write-up divergences (Cthugha, Sleipnir, Snake-Man); the App 4 IA restores (Encyclopedia, Indians, Ltd., in-cluded, Elric!) and the print oddities (Rowan & Littlefield, Bullfinch); the boldface doctrine pinned with the noted limitation; the INDEX headers not terms. The index grid rides one row per term (Ord + P1..P8 + Count, the 0 sentinel); the App 4 grid rides one row per entry (Ord, Year, Paperback, TwoVolumes, NoDate).

banner.title: Appendix 4 and the index - the D&DG walk round twenty-nine, print pp. 143-144: the seventeen bibliography entries and the 433-term index of proper names; the triple gap flip closes the App 3, App 4 and index boxes (census 23/1).
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (pdf 144-145; the index column runs read against the TSV geometry, the App 4 columns banded from the page top); the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print djvu text (the IA index dump interleaves the printed columns; the page digits reliable, the terms noisy). The adjudications: the leading-1 class (eight), the fused-glyph pages (four), the name garbles restored per the walk pins, the mechanical space restores, the Thrym 113 wrap, the Caduceus/Nemean 71 class, the print order quirks (seven), the word-convention sorts, the non-ascending citation lists, the double listings, the App 4 IA restores and print oddities, the boldface doctrine (the noted limitation), the INDEX headers not terms. The terms ride doc/data/ddg_index.txt; the bibliography rides doc/data/ddg_app4.txt.

data_files.content:
The DDG print pp. 143-144 index of proper names - the D&DG walk round
twenty-nine. The 433 terms across the six column runs (print p. 143 cols
1-3, print p. 144 cols 1-3; the pdf pages 144-145), alphabetical within
each run, with the per-term page citations AS PRINTED (the non-ascending
citations pinned: Surtur 121,108,113,123; Thoth 113,55; Hades
69,66,69,73 with the duplicate 69 real ink; Poseidon 73,63,64,67,72; Set
53,49,50,52,54; Tezcatlipoca 35,32,34). Primary ink: the extract/ddg
tesseract pass (the psm-4 dump collated against the archive.org 1st-
print djvu text). The headline restorations: the leading-1 drop class
(Idun 119, Apples of Youth 119, Brisingamen 117, Blodug-Hofi 117,
Skirnir 117, Semuanya 111, Laogzed 112, Freya 117 the z a 7); the fused-
glyph pages (Eadro 111, Vaprak 111, Jason 71, Harp of Calm 115); the
name garbles restored per the walk pins (R’lyeh, Surma, Surya, Osiris,
Apep, Fafhrd, Ilmarinen, Ilmatar, Itzamna, Ki, Girru, Grome, Hiisi,
Laogzed, Thrym, Lei Kung, Circe, Aegir, Galahad, Vishnu, Tyr, Susanowo,
Myyrrhn, Nnuurrr, Qagwaaz, Oonai, Ningauble of the 7 Eyes); the
mechanical space restores (Thunder Bird, Deep Ones, Gods of Trouble and
the rest); the Thrym 113 wrap restored (the IA voice plus the printed
trailing comma); the Thrym, Ningauble and Horus band strays noted; the
index headers and running heads noted, not terms. The print order quirks
pinned as printed (both voices agree): Ama-Tsu-Mara before Amaterasu,
Fire Sorcerers of the East before Fialar, Mi-Go before Mictlantecuhtli,
Spider, Salt before Spider God, Lu Yueh before Lugh, Nin-Hursag before
Ningauble, Yama’s Water Buffalo before Yamamoto Date; the word-
convention sorts (Ma Yuan before Magic Wool, Shan Hai Ching before
Shang-Ti, Gods of Trouble before Godsland) read as the word-by-word
convention, not quirks. The write-up pins ride where the index spellings
diverge: Cthugha, Sleipnir, Snake-Man (the index glyph runs noted). The
double listings pinned as printed: Karttikeya and Karttikeya, Peacock
of; Deep Sashelas and Sashelas, Deep; Master of the Hunt, Pack of the
Wild Hunt and Wild Hunt. Rake of Iron 57 rides as the best joint read of
two garbled voices (eyeball flag). Ankh, true rides the index capital
lowercased per the R857 grep-gate precedent (the write-up prints TRUE
ANKH). The terms print with trailing periods opening the dot leaders
(not carried here).
